responsibility: Implements the `function_base` classes for SiFive custom vector intrinsics layered on top of the RVV builtin framework. It defines how SiFive-specific operations such as `sf_vqmacc*` matrix multiply-accumulate forms and `sf_vfnrclip*` narrowing clip operations are expanded to exact RTL instruction codes, and instantiates the exported `bases::` objects referenced by the SiFive intrinsic definition tables.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation side of the same-stem SiFive builtin-bases pair: it defines the function_base subclasses, their expand methods, and the instantiated bases:: objects for sf_vqmacc* and sf_vfnrclip* intrinsics, whereas the header only declares those exported base objects.
